scope: Research-only audit of the public Chongqing 5G macro-cell release; no adapter, inventory, RF, calibration, default, or production change.

audited_release.reason_selected: This is the versioned Zenodo record linked by the current Data Descriptor and its file names match the current paper's Data Records section.
audited_release.release_ambiguity: A second official Zenodo record, 10.5281/zenodo.20564197, and the GitHub tree contain different file names, sizes, and checksums. The audit does not merge releases or treat the two records as interchangeable.

release_integrity_findings: The current checksums.txt values match the GitHub tree and the older 20564197 release, not the current 20564635 top-level files.
The current example script still loads base_station_data_processed.csv, while the current record lists base_station_data.csv.
The current record and the older record have different raw, grid, and base file sizes and hashes.
A future import must pin the exact record, file names, and independently verified checksums; it must fail closed on a release mismatch.

timestamp_delta_seconds_within_source_fi.interpretation: Compatible with the paper's nominal 1 Hz logging but not a continuous, gap-free route/session clock.

raw.caveat: The paper also describes UTC alignment for UAV flight logs; the public raw field is Beijing time and does not carry a timezone offset.
Retain ACCURACY(M); do not replace a raw observation with a grid center.

raw.meaning: smartphone GNSS estimated horizontal positioning uncertainty in metres
Cellular-Pro application-reported downlink data-rate indicator; no active speed-test traffic was generated

raw.caveat: 3GPP makes the 36-bit coding responsibility operator-specific; observed GNODEB*4096+GCELLID arithmetic is a dataset property, not a universal decoder.
No separately documented site_id/sector_id contract is released.

raw.meaning: cell identifier under the base station
raw.caveat: Use with NCI only as source reconciliation evidence; do not treat the 12-bit arithmetic partition as a general 3GPP rule.

raw.meaning: New Radio Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number
raw.target_use: channel identifier and conditional frequency derivation
raw.caveat: The standard formula yields plausible raw frequencies, but no exact join to the base Downlink Frequency field exists.
254 mapped observations across 32 NCI values disagree with base PCI.

raw.meaning: Synchronization Signal Reference Signal Received Power, reported in dBm
raw.caveat: The release does not specify SSB/resource averaging, device correction, detection floor, censoring, or an absolute receiver calibration. Only serving-cell observations are retained.

raw.meaning: Synchronization Signal Reference Signal Received Quality, reported in dB
Synchronization Signal Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio, reported in dB
source filename retained by the raw export
raw.caveat: It distinguishes UAV and ground naming in the scan but does not establish a documented route/session/campaign identifier.

base.meaning: base-table cell identity used by the official code as the join key
dataset-described base-station name plus cell identity
base.caveat: 23 of 189 values are rendered in scientific notation, so CGI is not a lossless text identity in the released CSV.

base.meaning: antenna azimuth clockwise from true north and described as main-beam direction
base.uncertainty_claim: The Nature paper reports operator/open-platform inference with cross-verification and approximately ±5 degrees azimuth uncertainty.

base.cross_check: No mapped raw TAC mismatches were observed.

base.meaning: dataset-described operating center frequency for downlink transmissions
base.caveat: The units/encoding are not stated. Treating values as NR-ARFCN gives plausible frequencies but zero exact agreement with raw NR_ARFCN and multiple non-constant deltas.
The 150 unique values include values such as 1, 5, 117, and 4144; no authoritative unit or coding contract reconciles them to raw N1/N78 observations.

base.meaning: allocated spectrum range, encoded as 100M, 40M, or 20M
base.caveat: The release does not state whether this is carrier bandwidth, configured channel bandwidth, or another allocation label.
No antenna coordinate reference, sign convention beyond the descriptive wording, or pattern is released.

base.meaning: dataset-described transmit power of the base-station antenna
base.target_use: source-only power field pending reference-plane decision
base.uncertainty_claim: The Nature paper reports approximately ±2 dB uncertainty for inferred transmit power.

base.caveat: Two rows are zero; the exact antenna reference point is not stated.

grid.meaning: average SS-RSRP within the grid cell
UAV flight-log altitude aligned to smartphone records using UTC
grid.caveat: It is not receiver height above local ground and does not describe ground-route receiver height.

grid.target_use: exclude interpolated cells from any future holdout

power.reported_as: transmit power of the base-station antenna
known: the current paper attributes the metadata to operator/open-platform inference and reports approximately ±2 dB uncertainty
unknown: whether antenna gain is already included
power.allowed_interpretation: source metadata only; do not map to absolute EIRP or received-power link-budget input

gain_and_pattern.consequence: The azimuth and tilts are not sufficient to reconstruct an angle-dependent antenna gain. An unknown pattern is not safely reducible to a constant offset.

geometry.azimuth: available, clockwise from true north, with paper-reported approximately ±5 degree uncertainty
geometry.height: available with two zero values and unspecified antenna reference point
geometry.receiver_height: missing for ground measurements; UAV ALT_M_ is flight-log altitude rather than receiver height above ground

receiver_and_measurement_semantics.device: iQOO 8 Pro smartphone with Qualcomm Snapdragon X60 5G modem for UAV measurements; the paper identifies smartphone receivers for ground routes but does not provide a separate ground device inventory.
receiver_and_measurement_semantics.uav_mount: Paper says the phone was fixed horizontally, screen upward, on the UAV upper surface in a custom 3D-printed holder.
receiver_and_measurement_semantics.uav_altitude: 5-200 m flight-log altitude; aligned to signal records using UTC; not equivalent to ground receiver height.
receiver_and_measurement_semantics.ground_route: Research assistants walked predefined routes through open squares, narrow alleys, and near base-station towers; exact route/session identifiers are not released in raw schema.
receiver_and_measurement_semantics.logging_rate: Paper states 1 Hz; raw within-file deltas contain gaps and are not an exact continuous 1-second series.
receiver_and_measurement_semantics.network_state: Phone locked to N1/N78; idle; no application-layer traffic; normal cell reselection and handover allowed.
receiver_and_measurement_semantics.serving_cell_scope: Only serving-cell measurements retained; neighbors excluded.
receiver_and_measurement_semantics.calibration: No receiver calibration file, antenna gain, device correction, receiver noise-floor characterization, or per-device identifier was found.

rsrp.safe_target: candidate rsrp_dbm for source-level quantity analysis
rsrp.grid_behavior: Grid SS_RSRP is an average/weighted aggregate and interpolated cells are not raw measurements.

environment_and_processing_semantics.study_area: 9 km2 around Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Yinglong Town, Nan'an District, Chongqing, China
environment_layers: global building footprints/heights with field correction
coordinate_systems: WGS84/UTM Zone 48N EPSG:32648 for projected processing
environment_and_processing_semantics.los_nlos: No per-observation measured LOS/NLOS label was found.
environment_and_processing_semantics.supplement_claim: The Nature paper says a reproducibility package contains all sampling points in SHP and application configuration settings; those files are not present in the audited 20564635 Zenodo file listing.
environment_and_processing_semantics.processing: Official code performs exact NCI-to-ECI dictionary matching, spatial joins, weighted/mode aggregation, and iterative interpolation; it does not provide receiver calibration, antenna patterns, power reference conversion, or an independent LOS calculation.

decision_relevance.quantity_descriptive_analysis: permitted at source level with provenance and serving-cell exclusions
